messages:
Maya: quick sync on toolkit pilot asks — customers want smart per-route batching/caching, quant presets, and eval-triggered regressions. need a conservative alpha plan.
Diego: Alpha proposal: recommendation API that returns human-readable rationale + confidence. Expose CLI/Console view. No auto-apply.
Priya: Eval alerts: start with a compare-against-baseline flow. Provide a heatmap of prompt failures, and allow custom metric webhooks.
Noah: For caching, include prefix-cache hints (suggest TTL and prefixes). For batching, suggest batch_size and concurrency targets per route.
Tess: Quant plans: provide named presets (+ runtime safety check). Ship an "int8-safe" preset that runs quick regression smoke tests before suggesting.
Maya: Ops constraints: sample inputs, store hashes, PII scrubber by default, org-level opt-out, all applies require audit log + approval. Add auto-rollback guardrail: if top-50 prompt degradation > threshold, revert.
Priya: Launch metrics: suggestion adoption rate (7d), % of suggestions reverted, alert precision (true positive rate).
Diego: Rough timeline: M1 suggestions API + scorer; M2 console + CLI; M3 alerts + pilot onboarding. Quant testing parallel but needs runtime signoff. 6 total sprints across squads.
Noah: UX mock idea: a compact Console card with impact estimate, confidence, and a one-click "Request Apply" that opens approval flow. Include a small diff view of config change.
Tess: Pilot candidates: HelixHealth, BrightNote, AtlasAI — will coordinate invites and golden prompt lists.
Maya: Action items: Diego -> brief RFC + API proto by Wed; Priya -> eval harness sketch + metric hook spec; Tess -> quant preset matrix + quick smoke tests; OpsBot: created checklist at /docs/playbooks/toolkit-pilot-checklist.md
OpsBot: checklist created: /docs/playbooks/toolkit-pilot-checklist.md
